title: Thoughts I Cannot Say Out Loud

current_concerns.primary_problems: Since the birth of her daughter, approximately 10 weeks ago, the patient has experienced frightening, unwanted images of her baby being harmed. These occur mostly at home, especially when bathing the baby alone. She repeatedly checks the baby at night and avoids caring for her alone because the thoughts frighten her.
